verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Apple-platform targets: an on-device iPhone app built on MLX Swift (Apple's framework for Apple Silicon) and a native Rust macOS CLI, daemon and desktop app. That implies some Apple Silicon-native execution, but nothing explicitly documents Metal kernels, ARM-specific optimizations or measured speedups on Macs. The SSD-offload and prerouter throughput gains are backend-agnostic, so they are not evidence for this story. Missing for 10: explicit Metal/MLX backend documentation for macOS, ARM/NEON optimization details, Apple Silicon benchmarks, independent corroboration.
